title: CouncilRecord
description: When parties cannot agree (e.g. a deletion vote fails to reach unanimity), the DISAGREEMENT ITSELF becomes a primary. Deadlock feeds the system rather than breaking it. Also the record form for any convened council around an unresolved question.

question.description: The unresolved question, e.g. 'Should primary prim_X be forgotten?'

subject_ref.description: The record the council is convened around.

attestation.description: Layer 3 attests to the legibility of the process. It does NOT appear as a party in positions[]. It never votes.

outcome.description: deadlock_recorded: no unanimity; nothing deleted; the disagreement persists as this primary.
